- **Approval:** I logged the request with June as the approver and sent her a DM asking for it. That DM doesn't include the $2,101 figure.
- **What I told Marcus:** I replied in his DM that the draft is on hold until June or Anselm approves. Once one of them does, I'll save it to Hollis at hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and the $2,101/seat figure. I also told him he can send Hollis the rate himself if he doesn't want to wait.
